facts.fact: PM-SYM was launched in February 2019 and is a voluntary, contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers
facts.quote: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM) scheme was launched in February, 2019 in order to provide old age protection to the workers of the unorganised sector. This is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme.

facts.fact: It gives an assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after the subscriber reaches age 60
facts.quote: Under the scheme, a monthly assured pension of Rs. 3000/- is provided to the unorganised workers after attaining the age of 60 years.

facts.fact: Unorganised workers aged 18 to 40 with monthly income of Rs 15,000 or less can join
facts.quote: The workers in the age group of 18 to 40 years whose monthly income is Rs. 15000/- or less

facts.fact: Members of EPFO, ESIC or NPS (Central Government-contributed) and income-tax payers are excluded
facts.quote: not a member of Employees Provident Fund Organization (EPFO)/Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)/National Pension System (NPS) (Contributed by Central Govt.) or not an income tax assessee are eligible to join the scheme.

facts.fact: The contribution is Rs 55 to Rs 200 per month depending on entry age
facts.quote: The monthly contribution amount ranges from Rs. 55/- to Rs. 200/-, depending upon the entry age of the beneficiary.

facts.fact: The worker pays 50% and the Central Government pays an equal matching contribution
facts.quote: Under the scheme, 50% monthly contribution is payable by the beneficiary and equal matching contribution is paid by the Central Government.

facts.fact: The subscriber must make regular age-specific monthly contributions
facts.quote: The applicant must be an unorganised worker in the entry age group of 18 to 40 years with a monthly income of ₹15,000/- or less, and must make regular age-specific monthly contributions.

facts.fact: Pension starts only after age 60; as the scheme began in February 2019, no pension is paid before February 2039
facts.quote: Since the scheme was launched in February, 2019, the disbursement of pension will start not before February, 2039.

facts.fact: Dormant accounts can be revived within 3 years (extended from one year)
facts.quote: Extension of the revival period of dormant accounts from one year to three years.

facts.fact: As on 29.07.2026 more than 54 lakh beneficiaries had enrolled (PIB, 03 Aug 2026)
facts.quote: As on 29.07.2026, more than 54 lakh beneficiaries have been enrolled under the PM-SYM scheme across the country.

facts.fact: Enrolment is at a Common Service Centre (CSC), or self-enrolment on www.maandhan.in
facts.quote: Enrolment in the Scheme is done through the Common Service Centres, with its network of about 4 lakh Centres across the country. Eligible unorganised workers can also self-enrol through visiting the portal www.maandhan.in

facts.fact: Documents needed: Aadhaar card and a savings bank / Jan-Dhan account passbook, plus a mobile number
facts.quote: Documents Required Aadhaar Card Savings Bank Account Passbook / Jan-Dhan Account Passbook Mobile Number

facts.fact: The first contribution is paid at enrolment
facts.quote: The subscriber must then pay the full amount of the first subscription in cash to the VLE, who will generate a receipt and hand it over to the subscriber.

facts.fact: Later monthly contributions are auto-debited from the linked savings or Jan-Dhan account
facts.quote: The mandatory monthly subscription shall be automatically debited on a fixed date every single month from the subscriber's linked saving account or Jan-Dhan account.

summary: All PM-SYM facts confirmed: pension, eligibility, contribution, 2039, revival and enrolment count on PIB (03 Aug 2026); documents and the auto-debit steps on myScheme.
